subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support remote `http(s)` avatars, or should remote avatar inputs remain blocked and documented/validated as unsupported for Control UI rendering?
rationale: The remaining behavior affects CSP, privacy, browser network fetching, avatar route auth, and the public avatar configuration contract, so automation should not choose the policy silently.

options.title: Keep local/data-only avatars
options.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and align CLI/docs/validation/UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

options.title: Build a same-origin proxy/cache
options.body: Support remote avatars through a gateway-owned proxy/cache with explicit MIME, size, auth, caching, privacy, and failure-feedback behavior.

options.title: Allow direct remote fetches
options.body: Let browsers load configured remote avatar URLs directly and accept the associated CSP and operator-browser privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep local/data-only avatars
recommendation.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and align CLI/docs/validation/UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history signal across the avatar resolver, route, docs, and Control UI security boundary.
